note: The allowed side of the delivery-coverage guard. A representation-disputed fact clears the claim to none (reg_meta_build/DESIGN.md, Delivery coverage accounting), and a cleared claim is never compared (old: an unknown claim passes any written fact), so the build reports no issue.
